historical_rebuild_na_reason: mixed or unknown execution environments; no extrapolation
planning_scope: once per unique input plus preparation/classification/grid/serialization; repeats are benchmark cost
campaign_elapsed_scope: run.py after its initial source guard through physical execution, benchmarking, classification, G0/G1 analysis and final bookkeeping; excludes earlier protocol preparation and later reporting/audit
postprocessing_scope: finalize, supplement, figures and independent audit; no extra E or R physical runs

one_planning_ledger.note: Cache processing includes R reclassification, so do not sum it again with the full classifier field. Benchmark repetitions are research measurement cost, not one planning execution.
one_planning_ledger.NA_reason: The campaign interleaves measurement repeats and refinement; controller/input/serialization components are recorded but a separate repeat-free end-to-end planning run was not authorized or executed.
unmeasured_components: controller JSON transport/parse separated from measured object preparation
controller-side grid selection and miscellaneous output writing separately from measured analysis modules

actual_R_timing_scope: adapter invocation including initialization/extraction, result dataclass materialization and stdout log context; subsequent JSON/gzip output and six-SLA classification are outside this timer
E_timing_scope: simulate on prepared objects, including default diagnostics and trajectory hashing; additional repeat-verification hash and JSON/gzip output are outside this timer
peak_memory_limitation: process-lifetime high-water mark, not isolated per-call or per-model allocation
